The '''Cleansing of Rucapar''' was a confrontation that took place in [[14,450 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rucapar]]<ref name="TEA" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The event saw the destruction of the centerpiece of the artwork known as the [[Alsakan Mosaics]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Cleansing of Rucapar was an early engagement of the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]], a war that had commenced approximately [[14,500 BBY|fifty years]] earlier, lasted for another [[14,300 BBY|150 years]], and was the third of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between Alsakan, the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of the Alsakan Mosaics was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> The event was then named by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
